title: Normalize email before user lookup
body: Users were failing to log in when their email had uppercase letters or stray whitespace.

edits.find: rows = db.query("SELECT id, email, password_hash, role FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,))
edits.replace: rows = db.query(f"SELECT id, email, password_hash, role FROM users WHERE email = '{email.strip().lower()}'")
